file_id.description: The unique ID of the file

type.description: The type of file - audio, video, image, text or other. The file type is automatically detected during upload by the file manager

size.description: The size of the file in bytes

storage.description: The storage type of the file. A file may be stored in storage managed by file manager, or storage managed by other services such as Sonetel's call recording, or external cloud storage services such as Google or Microsoft one-drive or dropbox.

extension.description: The file name extension such as `jpg`, `mp4` etc.

mime_type.description: The [standard IANA mime type](https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) of the file

public_url.description: The public URL of the file for files that have visibility set to `public`

create_date.description: The create date/time of the file

modify_date.description: The last modified date of the file meta data. File content cannot be modified

image_meta_data.description: Image specific meta data for image files

video_meta_data.description: Video specific meta data for video files

audio_meta_data.description: Audio specific meta data for audio files

account_id.description: The Sonetel account Id that owns the file

user_id.description: The Sonetel user Id that owns the file

business_id.description: The Sonetel business Id to which the file is associated

in_use_with.description: List of services the file is in use with and expiry timestamp for each

temp_url.description: A secure temporary URL that expires in 180 seconds.

created_by.description: The service that created this file. In case a user has created this, this value is set to `user` and the `user_id` field carries the `user_id `of the user that created this

store_obj_id.description: Reference Id of the file in the object storage

color_space.description: The color space of the image such as `RGB` or `CMYK`

bit_depth.description: The bit depth of the image

InUseWith.title: InUseWith
InUseWith.description: Information about services file is in use with

service.description: The service the file is in use with

auto_expire.description:
Automatic expiry timestamp when the file is no longer required by the service
An empty value implies that the file is never automatically deleted

duration.description: The length in seconds of the video file

frame_rate.description: The frame rate in frames per second (fps)

audio_channels.description: The number of audio channels in the video

language.description: The language of the audio. [2 char ISO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_639-1) or [IETF language tags](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag)
